hints.title: Independent Bit Contribution
hints.text: Any bit position that appears as 1 in at least one element will be set to 1 in exactly half of all non-empty subsets.

hints.title: Bitwise OR Aggregation
hints.text: The bitwise OR of all elements identifies every bit that can be set in any subset.

hints.title: Power of Two Multiplier
hints.text: Multiply the cumulative bitwise OR by 2^(n - 1) to obtain the total sum of all subset exclusive-or totals.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 2^n subsets takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitwise mathematical independence computes the total sum across all subsets in a single O(n) pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate leverages the property that each active bit is set in 2^(n-1) subsets.
